name: Undertaking Confirmation 1
definition: Confirmation information for the issued undertaking.

Confirmer.name: Confirmer
Confirmer.definition: Party that adds its undertaking to honour the undertaking or amendment of the undertaking.

ReferenceNumber.name: Reference Number
ReferenceNumber.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier assigned by the confirmer to the undertaking.

Date.name: Date
Date.definition: Date and time when the undertaking or amendment of the undertaking was confirmed.

Confirmation.name: Confirmation
Confirmation.definition: Confirmation of the undertaking or amendment of the confirmed undertaking.
